method: Theil–Sen flat-bottom baseline slopes and median caplines measured after four-times Lanczos sampling; fitted bounds are converted back to native pixel coordinates. One uniform scale per physical source page; independent row baselines; no individual glyph-height normalization.

regular-10-n.note: Independent baseline for the distant numeral block. Observed baseline figures anchor one rigid transform; all figures retain their source-relative positions at the same physical page scale. No individual figure height or baseline normalization.

regular-10-census-n.note: Independent baseline for the distant numeral block. Observed baseline figures anchor one rigid transform; all figures retain their source-relative positions at the same physical page scale. No individual figure height or baseline normalization.

handy-358-10-caps.method: Independent native stem-foot windows at T150; median column lower ink edges, Theil-Sen slope, median intercept. Rounded feet and S excluded. Whole glyphs remain unsliced.
handy-358-10-caps.coordinate_convention: Native pixels occupy [y,y+1); each lower edge is the last black pixel row plus one.
handy-358-10-caps.review: All native stem-foot windows and full line overlays visually reviewed. No common row rotation measured; one-pixel maximum baseline residual. Curved feet and S excluded.

broad_S_scale.method: One isotropic fit to non-S whole capitals after independently accepted native serif-foot row rotation. All S and joined groups excluded.
